name: Alligator
appearance: An aquatic reptile with a broad snout, gaping jaws, and a heavy tail.

Trait.name: Hold Breath
Trait.effectNote: It can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

Trait.name: Condition resistance
Trait.effectNote: The block lists resistance to grappled.

Action.name: Bite
Action.effectNote: A hit grapples the target (escape DC 12). The target is restrained during the grapple, and the alligator cannot use Bite on another target.

Bonus action.name: High Walk
Bonus action.effectNote: It can Dash as a bonus action while it is out of the water or otherwise not swimming.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 10 and Stealth 12. Ability modifiers are STR +2, DEX +0, CON +1, INT −4, WIS +0, CHA −5.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 215.

name: Alligator Turtle
appearance: A sturdy shelled reptile with a long flexible neck, a hooked beak and a wormlike tongue lure.

Trait.name: False Appearance
Trait.effectNote: While motionless underwater with its mouth open, it looks like a rock with a worm sticking out of it. The lure is its tongue.

Trait.name: Hold Breath
Trait.effectNote: It can hold its breath for 1 hour.

Trait.name: Condition resistance
Trait.effectNote: The block lists resistance to prone.

Action.name: Bite
Action.effectNote: A hit grapples the target (escape DC 12). The turtle cannot bite another target during that grapple.

Reaction.name: Spiky Shell
Reaction.effectNote: When a visible attacker within 5 ft. hits the turtle, reduce the attack damage by 5 (2d4). The attacker takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 11 and Stealth 13. Ability modifiers are STR +2, DEX +1, CON +1, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −2.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 215.

name: Baboon, Howler
appearance: A stocky baboon that warns its troop with loud whooping calls.

Trait.name: Pack Tactics
Trait.effectNote: The baboon has advantage against a target within 5 ft. of one of the baboon’s allies who is not incapacitated.

Trait.name: Condition resistance
Trait.effectNote: The block lists resistance to deafened.

Bonus action.name: Challenging Howl
Bonus action.effectNote: One creature it sees within 30 ft. makes a DC 12 CHA save. On a failure, the baboon chooses whether the target’s next attack before the baboon’s next turn has disadvantage or has to target the baboon.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 13 and Stealth 12. Ability modifiers are STR +2, DEX +2, CON +2, INT −2, WIS +1, CHA −2.
No languages.
The Rock attack prints 20/60 ft. as “reach,” which the profile displays as a ranged attack’s normal and long range.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 232.

name: Bat, Strossen
appearance: A black vampire bat with a white streak across its eyes.

Trait.name: Echolocation
Trait.effectNote: It loses keensense while deafened.

Trait.name: Heightened Hearing
Trait.effectNote: Use Perception 17 when it relies on hearing.

Trait.name: Condition resistance
Trait.effectNote: The block lists resistance to blinded.

Trait.name: Condition vulnerability
Trait.effectNote: The block lists vulnerability to deafened.

Action.name: Bite
Action.effectNote: On a hit it attaches, moves with the target for free and cannot attack while attached. The target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) HP to blood loss at the start of each bat turn. The bat can spend 5 ft. of movement to detach, and does so after draining 15 HP or if the target dies. Any creature, including the target, can use an action to remove it.

Bonus action.name: Haunting Screech
Bonus action.effectNote: Choose one creature within 10 ft. If it can hear the bat, it must pass a DC 13 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 12 and Stealth 15. Ability modifiers are STR −2, DEX +3, CON +0, INT −5, WIS +0, CHA −4.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 239.

name: Beetle, Giant Bombardier
appearance: A dome-backed beetle that can spray a scalding liquid to fend off predators.

Trait.name: Forest Camouflage
Trait.effectNote: Use Stealth 17 in forest terrain.

Trait.name: Condition vulnerability
Trait.effectNote: The block lists vulnerability to frightened.

Action.name: Spray (Recharge 5–6)
Action.effectNote: One creature it can see within 15 ft. makes a DC 12 DEX save. Failure deals 5 (2d4) fire damage. Success halves that damage.

Reaction.name: Defensive Spray (7 HP or fewer)
Reaction.effectNote: When the beetle takes damage while at 7 HP or fewer, Spray recharges and the beetle can use it immediately.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 10 and Stealth 12. Ability modifiers are STR +0, DEX +2, CON +2, INT −4, WIS +0, CHA −4.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 226.

name: Bull
appearance: A bulky, four-legged bovine with a heavy head and sharp horns.

Trait.name: Charge
Trait.effectNote: Move at least 20 ft. in a straight line toward the target and hit it with Gore on the same turn. Add 3 (1d6) piercing damage. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 13 STR save or fall prone.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 9 and Stealth 11. Ability modifiers are STR +3, DEX +1, CON +3, INT −4, WIS −1, CHA −2.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 219.

name: Forest Falcon
appearance: A broad-winged raptor adapted to agile flight through dense canopy.

Trait.name: Falcon Dive
Trait.effectNote: Dive straight toward the target for at least 20 ft. while flying. Gain advantage on the next Beak attack against it this turn. A hit adds 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

Trait.name: Heightened Sight
Trait.effectNote: Use Perception 19 when relying on sight.

Trait.name: Condition vulnerability
Trait.effectNote: The block lists vulnerability to blinded.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 14 and Stealth 13. Ability modifiers are STR −2, DEX +3, CON +1, INT −4, WIS +2, CHA −3.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 226.

name: Grove Bear
appearance: A nimble, compact black-bear relative with a blond snout.

Trait.name: Grappler
Trait.effectNote: It has advantage on attacks against creatures it is grappling.

Trait.name: Heightened Smell
Trait.effectNote: Use Perception 18 when relying on smell.

Trait.name: Condition resistance
Trait.effectNote: The block lists resistance to grappled.

Action.name: Claws
Action.effectNote: A hit grapples the target (escape DC 13). It cannot use Claws on another target while the grapple persists.

Bonus action.name: Pin
Bonus action.effectNote: One creature the bear is grappling must pass a DC 13 STR save or be restrained until the grapple ends.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 13 and Stealth 11. Ability modifiers are STR +3, DEX +1, CON +2, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −2.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 229.

name: Leech, Giant
appearance: An elongated, legless leech that swims with a vertical undulation.

Trait.name: Amphibious
Trait.effectNote: It breathes air and water.

Action.name: Bite
Action.effectNote: On a hit it attaches, moves with the target for free and cannot attack while attached. The target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) HP to blood loss at the start of each leech turn. The leech can spend 5 ft. of movement to detach, and does so after draining 10 HP or if the target dies. Any creature, including the target, can use an action to remove it.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 10 and Stealth 15. Ability modifiers are STR −2, DEX +3, CON +0, INT −5, WIS +0, CHA −4.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 227.

name: Lizard, Giant Frilled
appearance: A large, warm-climate lizard with a jagged neck frill that it spreads to intimidate intruders.

Action.name: Multiattack
Action.effectNote: It makes one Bite and one Tail attack.

Action.name: Tail
Action.effectNote: A Large or smaller creature hit by the tail must pass a DC 15 STR save or fall prone.

Bonus action.name: Intimidating Dash
Bonus action.effectNote: Move up to 20 ft. toward one creature it sees within 60 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks. If it comes within 30 ft. of the target, the target makes a DC 15 CHA save or becomes frightened until the start of the lizard’s next turn. The save has disadvantage if the lizard comes within 5 ft.

Reaction.name: Detach Tail (63 HP or fewer)
Reaction.effectNote: When it takes damage at 63 HP or fewer, reduce the damage by 9 (2d8) and immediately move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It cannot make Tail attacks again until this reaction recharges after a short or long rest.

Trait.name: Condition resistance
Trait.effectNote: The block lists resistance to poisoned.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 14 and Stealth 14. Ability modifiers are STR +2, DEX +4, CON +2, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA +0.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 227.

name: Margreve Hound
appearance: A muscular hunting hound bred in the Margreve and touched by the forest’s magic.

Trait.name: Fearsome Mien
Trait.effectNote: A Fey attacking the hound must pass a DC 12 WIS save or make that attack with disadvantage.

Trait.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
Trait.effectNote: Use Perception 18 when relying on smell. The rules text names smell only.

Trait.name: Magic Resistance
Trait.effectNote: It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

Trait.name: Condition resistance
Trait.effectNote: The block lists resistance to charmed, frightened.

Action.name: Bite
Action.effectNote: A hit grapples the target (escape DC 12). It cannot bite another target while the grapple persists.

Bonus action.name: Warning Bark
Bonus action.effectNote: Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 12 WIS save or cannot move closer to the hound until the start of the hound’s next turn. Fey have disadvantage on this save.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 13 and Stealth 13. Ability modifiers are STR +2, DEX +1, CON +1, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −2.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 235.

name: Margreve Stag
appearance: A large antlered deer native to the Margreve Forest.

Trait.name: Charge
Trait.effectNote: Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Ram on the same turn. Add 2 (1d4) damage. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 12 STR save or fall prone.

Trait.name: Heightened Hearing
Trait.effectNote: Use Perception 15 when relying on hearing.

Trait.name: Standing Leap
Trait.effectNote: It can jump up to 20 ft. horizontally or 10 ft. vertically, with or without a run-up.

Trait.name: Condition resistance
Trait.effectNote: The block lists resistance to exhaustion.

Trait.name: Condition vulnerability
Trait.effectNote: The block lists vulnerability to frightened.

Bonus action.name: Skittish
Bonus action.effectNote: It takes the Dash or Disengage action.

Reaction.name: Will of the Margreve
Reaction.effectNote: When it fails a saving throw, it can reroll and must accept the new result.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 10 and Stealth 12. Ability modifiers are STR +2, DEX +2, CON +1, INT −3, WIS +0, CHA −1.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), pp. 235–236.

name: Mongoose, Giant
appearance: A long-bodied mongoose that dodges strikes with quick, dance-like movements.

Trait.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
Trait.effectNote: Use Perception 17 when relying on hearing or smell.

Trait.name: Condition resistance
Trait.effectNote: The block lists resistance to poisoned.

Reaction.name: Evasive Roll
Reaction.effectNote: If it sees the attacker, add 2 AC against one attack that would hit it.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 12 and Stealth 15. Ability modifiers are STR +0, DEX +3, CON +2, INT −4, WIS +2, CHA −2.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), pp. 227–228.

name: Owl, Great Gray
appearance: A gray owl with a broad round facial disk and a quiet wingbeat.

Trait.name: Flyby
Trait.effectNote: Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke its opportunity attacks.

Trait.name: Heightened Hearing and Sight
Trait.effectNote: Use Perception 19 when relying on hearing or sight.

Trait.name: Quiet Wings
Trait.effectNote: Use Stealth 21 while flying.

Bonus action.name: Intense Gaze
Bonus action.effectNote: Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. On a failed DC 14 WIS save, the owl has advantage on its next attack against that creature before the start of the owl’s next turn.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 14 and Stealth 16. Ability modifiers are STR −3, DEX +4, CON +0, INT −4, WIS +2, CHA −2.
No languages.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 229.

name: Tsuchinoko
appearance: A compact venomous snake that can bite its tail and roll like a hoop.

Trait.name: Heightened Smell
Trait.effectNote: Use Perception 18 when relying on smell.

Trait.name: Plant Camouflage
Trait.effectNote: Use Stealth 21 amid enough plant growth to hide.

Trait.name: Standing Leap
Trait.effectNote: It can jump up to 15 ft. horizontally or 5 ft. vertically, with or without a run-up.

Action.name: Leaping Bite
Action.effectNote: It has advantage on this attack if it moves at least 10 ft. before attacking.

Bonus action.name: Hoop Dash
Bonus action.effectNote: It takes the Dash action after biting its own tail to form a hoop. Its next attack before its next turn has disadvantage.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 13 and Stealth 16. Ability modifiers are STR −3, DEX +4, CON +1, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −3.
No languages.
It hunts small prey and seeks out alcohol, which sometimes brings it to roadside inns.
Source: Kobold Press, The Old Margreve (Tales of the Valiant), p. 241.
